text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 131 tablets of apixaban 5 mg at 8.7 tablets per day, providing 15.1 days on hand. Corvale General holds 274 tablets at 10.5 tablets per day, providing 26 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show apixaban is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 15 to 26 days depending on site. No FDA shortage listing exists. One product label names MSN Laboratories Private Limited in Telangana, India as the manufacturing plant, though the plant is not placed in our supply chain. The rule-based best option is E.R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place. An alternate manufacturer option ranked 3 is Indoco Remedies Limited, also not on FDA's shortage list today with no plant named on its label we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with E.R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C. to replenish stock at both sites. Approval required from Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to qualify Indoco Remedies Limited as a secondary source. Approval required from Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee.

Not recommended: No allocation changes or clinical substitutions at this time.
